package: @astryxdesign/lab

# CommentThread

A comment thread shows one conversation: its first comment and the replies under it. Use it where a surface shows a single thread, such as a margin card beside a document or a popover opened from a highlight. To show many threads with a composer for new ones, use Comments.

**Import:** `import {CommentThread} from '@astryxdesign/lab';`

## Anatomy

| Element | Required | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| Surface | Yes | An outlined Card on a page, or a Section without outer rules inside a card or popover. A press anywhere on it opens the thread; a visually hidden toggle carries its name and focus. |
| Quoted passage | No | The passage an inline comment discusses, as an italic blockquote ruled in the highlight color, with an Outdated badge once the passage is edited away. |
| First comment | Yes | Avatar, header (name, time, Edited, Resolved, and the actions shown on hover or focus), Markdown body clamped to three lines until the thread opens, and reactions. |
| Replies | No | One level of replies behind View replies, joined to the first comment by an avatar rail while the thread is open. A host-marked unread reply reveals without selecting the thread, moving focus, or opening the reply composer. |
| Live state | No | Controlled typing state follows the conversation while the thread is open, with its pulsing dots in the avatar column and its label on the comment-text line. Controlled `seenBy` metadata remains available to comment render callbacks but has no default presentation. |
| Reply composer | No | A CommentComposer that opens with the thread, beside the viewer’s avatar. |

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Inside a card or popover, set `container="card"` and give the card no padding: the thread supplies its own insets and draws no outer rules.
- **Do:** Control `isSelected` when the thread opens from elsewhere, such as its highlight in a document. Controlled selection reveals the body and replies without moving focus or opening the reply composer.
- **Do:** In a Popover over a document, pass `onDismiss` and pair it with `hasLightDismiss={false}` and `hasEscapeDismiss={false}` on the host Popover. A press outside the thread or Escape then closes it, except that the first one over an unsaved reply or edit shakes the thread and keeps the draft.
- **Do:** Map your collaboration state to `typingUsers` and `seenBy`, then publish local reply and edit activity with `onComposerDraftChange`. `seenBy` stays hidden unless a comment render callback presents it. The thread never opens a connection or expires participants.
- **Don't:** Stack several CommentThreads with a composer to build a discussion. Use Comments, which keeps one thread open at a time and orders threads with activity.
- **Don't:** Wrap the thread in your own button or link to open it. The thread is already one toggle; a second control nests interactive elements.
- **Don't:** Leave the host Popover’s light dismiss on while passing `onDismiss`. The browser closes the Popover before the thread can keep a draft.

## Accessibility

- **Escape:** With `onDismiss`, Escape dismisses the thread only when no layer inside it is open. An open emoji picker, menu, or dialog closes first, one Escape at a time.
- **Unsaved draft warning:** When a dismissal would discard an unsaved reply or edit, the thread stays open, focus returns to the draft, and a polite live region says the draft is unsaved and that dismissing again discards it. The shake is never the only signal.
- **Reduced motion:** Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the thread does not shake. Focus and the announcement still mark the kept draft.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `comment` | `CommentThreadData` | - | The thread: its first comment, carrying its replies, reactions, optional anchor, transient `typingUsers`, and per-comment `seenBy` metadata. `seenBy` is not rendered by default but remains available to comment render callbacks. **(required)** |
| `isSelected` | `boolean` | - | Whether the thread is open, controlled: body unclamped and replies shown. Omit it to let the thread own selection. Host-controlled selection never moves focus or opens the reply composer; a viewer Reply action does. |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(isSelected: boolean) => void` | - | Called when the viewer opens or closes the thread. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | - | Hands the thread its anchored host’s light dismissal. A press outside the thread, or an Escape no layer inside it handled, calls it. While a reply or edit holds unsaved text, the first request instead shakes the thread, returns focus to the draft, and announces; the next consecutive request dismisses, and typing or pressing inside the thread re-arms the warning. Pair it with `hasLightDismiss={false}` and `hasEscapeDismiss={false}` on the host Popover. Omit it and the thread never dismisses anything. |
| `currentUser` | `CommentUser` | - | The viewer, for own-comment actions and the reply avatar. |
| `mode` | `'interactive' \| 'non-editable' \| 'read-only'` | `'interactive'` | Which actions show, as on Comments. |
| `container` | `'section' \| 'card'` | `'section'` | The parent surface: an outlined Card on a page, or a Section without outer rules inside a card or popover. |
| `onSubmit` | `(content: string, parentCommentId?: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Posts a reply, always with the thread’s first comment as the parent. A rejected Promise restores the draft and shows an error with Retry. |
| `onComposerDraftChange` | `(value: string, context: CommentComposerContext) => void` | - | Reports internally owned reply and edit drafts, including seeds and an empty value after submit, cancel, or a target switch. Route updates by `context` and own transport timing in your app. |
| `onSaveEdit` | `(commentId: string, content: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Edit to the viewer’s own comments and saves the new Markdown. |
| `onDelete` | `(commentId: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Delete to the viewer’s own comments, confirmed in a dialog first. |
| `onReact` | `(commentId: string, reactionKey: string, option?: CommentReactionOption) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Toggles the viewer’s reaction by its stable key. |
| `onRetryComment` | `(commentId: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Retry to a comment whose `status` is `error`. |
| `onResolveThread` | `(commentId: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Mark as resolved to an open thread. |
| `onReopenThread` | `(commentId: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Reopen to a resolved thread. |
| `loadVersions` | `(commentId: string) => Promise<readonly CommentVersion[]>` | - | Loads a comment’s edit history, newest first. |
| `onUploadImages` | `(files: readonly File[], context: CommentComposerContext) => CommentUploadedImage[] \| Promise<CommentUploadedImage[]>` | - | Uploads images attached, pasted, or dropped in the reply composer and appends them as Markdown images. |
| `isSubmitting` | `boolean` | `false` | Host-controlled pending state for the reply composer. |
| `composerPlaceholder` | `string` | - | Placeholder of the reply composer. Defaults to the localized "Reply to <name>…". |
| `highlightColor` | `'blue' \| 'cyan' \| 'gray' \| 'green' \| 'orange' \| 'pink' \| 'purple' \| 'red' \| 'teal' \| 'yellow'` | `'yellow'` | The palette color your app highlights the thread’s passage in. |
| `reactionOptions` | `readonly CommentReactionOption[]` | `DEFAULT_COMMENT_REACTIONS` | The reactions Add reaction offers. |
| `agentCommands` | `readonly CommentAgentCommand[]` | - | Agents a reply can address with a `/` command. |
| `composerTriggers` | `readonly ChatComposerTrigger[]` | - | Typeahead triggers for the reply composer, such as an `@` people search. |
| `markdownPlugins` | `readonly MarkdownPluginEntry[]` | - | Block Markdown plugins for comment bodies. |
| `markdownInlinePlugins` | `readonly MarkdownInlinePlugin[]` | - | Inline Markdown plugins for comment bodies, such as mentions. |
| `getReplyMention` | `(author: CommentUser) => string \| undefined` | - | Seeds a reply to a reply with a mention of its author. |
| `hasEmojiPicker` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the reply composer offers the emoji picker. |
| `renderAnchor` | `(comment: CommentThreadData, defaultAnchor: ReactNode) => ReactNode` | - | Replaces the thread’s quoted passage. |
| `renderBody` | `(comment: CommentData) => ReactNode` | - | Replaces a comment’s Markdown body. |
| `renderVersionBody` | `(version: CommentVersion) => ReactNode` | - | Replaces the body of a version in the edit history. |
| `renderAdditionalActions` | `(comment: CommentData) => ReactNode` | - | Adds product actions to a comment’s header. |
| `renderComposer` | `(props: CommentComposerRenderProps) => ReactNode` | - | Replaces the reply composer’s input while the thread keeps its draft and state. |

## Examples

### Margin comment

```tsx
import {Card} from '@astryxdesign/core/Card';
import {CommentThread} from '@astryxdesign/lab';

<Card padding={0} width={320}>
  <CommentThread
    comment={{
      id: 'margin',
      author: {id: 'maya', name: 'Maya Chen'},
      body: 'Should this say three days? The dry run adds one.',
      createdAt: '2026-09-30T19:00:00Z',
      anchor: {quote: 'The final cohort completes rollout in two days.'},
    }}
    currentUser={{id: 'avery', name: 'Avery Kim'}}
    container="card"
    onSubmit={(body, parentId) => postReply(parentId, body)}
  />
</Card>
```

### In a popover that keeps unsaved drafts

```tsx
import {useState} from 'react';
import {Button} from '@astryxdesign/core/Button';
import {Popover} from '@astryxdesign/core/Popover';
import {CommentThread} from '@astryxdesign/lab';

function CommentPopover({thread, viewer}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Popover
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onOpenChange={setIsOpen}
      hasLightDismiss={false}
      hasEscapeDismiss={false}
      label="Comment"
      padding={0}
      width={340}
      content={
        <CommentThread
          comment={thread}
          currentUser={viewer}
          container="card"
          isSelected
          onSubmit={(body, parentId) => postReply(parentId, body)}
          onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
        />
      }>
      <Button label="1 comment" variant="secondary" />
    </Popover>
  );
}
```
